title: Comparative Analysis of Wild-Type and bPACy Cells under Blue Light Illumination
summary: This cluster focuses on the comparison of wild-type (WT) cells and bPACy cells under different conditions. WT cells were exposed to blue light and darkness, while bPACy cells were incubated in darkness and exposed to blue light. The proteome and metabolome of both cell types were analyzed, showing that bPACy cells have a lower adenylate energy charge and higher abundance of certain chemicals. The regulation of cAMP and its hydrolysis by Pde1 and Pde2 were also investigated, highlighting their role in regulating various processes. The study provides insights into the effects of blue light illumination on the two cell types.
